cleaner.summary: Zero blocking findings remain. K-1 and L-1 are resolved, and this delta introduces no novel correctness, masked-failure, or resource-bound defect in shipped behavior. No advisory/hardening finding warrants another revision.
verifiedClaims: Refusal state has a compile-time-fixed three-cause set (oversized-line, queue-full-lines, queue-full-bytes) stored in one fixed-size record (src/console/console.ts:60-69,1109-1122); it cannot grow with input variety or line count.

Each rejected line increments exactly one primary cause; an already-full line queue is classified as line-capacity refusal while byte-capacity refusal remains distinct when the byte bound is reached first (src/console/console.ts:1025-1041,1054-1068).

Same-chunk oversized input no longer clears its diagnostic at the terminating newline: discard state resets but pending refusal evidence remains until publication, exit, or close (src/console/console.ts:997-1006,1125-1127).

Multiple causes arriving before publication merge into the same bounded object; counts added while an earlier snapshot is blocked in output are subtracted only after that snapshot publishes, then emitted in the next bounded frame (src/console/console.ts:1129-1171,1180-1188).

The publication protocol is sound under backpressure: it snapshots all three counts plus a revision, emits one stream write, and clears only when no newer refusal arrived, preventing both lost causes and double-reporting.
Retained refusal does not improperly leak across saturation episodes; memory remains O(1); exit/close clears it without waiting on stdout.

New drills assert observable terminal results rather than shallow call order: same-chunk oversized refusal, continued command-loop usability, mixed-cause counts, transient-backpressure retention, distinct byte-capacity reporting, non-echo of rejected payloads, FIFO, and unchanged queue bounds.
cleaner.notedNonBlocking: Counters use JavaScript numbers; precision would theoretically degrade beyond Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER, but exceeding nine quadrillion refused lines in one unpublished process lifetime is not a credible shipped path and does not justify a blocker or advisory.

architect.summary: L-1 is resolved without weakening the previously cleared input, terminal, delivery, or resource-bound contracts. The delta uses one fixed-size refusal aggregate with per-cause counters and safely accounts for refusals that arrive before or during a backpressured publication.
verifiedClaims: Refusal causes are a closed, fixed-size set (src/console/console.ts:61-68).
reportInputRefusal increments the appropriate counter in the single pending object instead of suppressing later causes (src/console/console.ts:1109-1122).

Publication snapshots counts and revision; refusals arriving during a stalled write remain in the same object and are emitted in a subsequent bounded frame rather than lost (src/console/console.ts:1129-1170,1180-1188).
Exit and close still clear pending refusal state immediately and do not wait for output recovery (src/console/console.ts:978-990,1077-1087).

Preserved contracts: accepted lines remain FIFO with the 16-line / 64 KiB / 8 KiB bounds; refused payloads are not echoed; Ctrl-C/Ctrl-D remain synchronously observable and independent of an active reader or output recovery; echo publication remains coalesced and bounded; admission remains gateway-authoritative; delivery readiness, publication-proof-before-commit, atomic terminal frames and bounded exit are unchanged.

Mixed-cause integration drill exercises operation-cap saturation plus one chunk containing an oversized line, 16 accepted lines and one excess normal command (test/integration/console.test.ts:1228-1290); the unit drill covers the same interaction while stdout is backpressured and verifies one combined frame after recovery (test/unit/console.test.ts:481-535).
architect.productRuling: Product is CLEAR for this scoped checkpoint. The local owner console's refusal reporting is now complete and bounded. The owner-deferred live Discord configured-route round trip remains the separate G013 final gate and does not reduce this checkpoint's Product status.
